name: BUSTER PASS (HALLOWEEN '26)
displayDescription:
Unlocks the second row of the Halloween '26 pass, granting 1 extra item skin per tier! Collect Candy to unlock the Buster Lighter, Buster Battery Pack, Buster Lantern, Buster Gold Blaster, Buster Flashlight, Buster Crucifix, and Buster Scanner skins! All skins designed by @Varzkitt

NOTE: YOU DO NOT NEED THIS GAMEPASS TO UNLOCK THE GHOST ITEM SKINS FROM THE HALLOWEEN '26 PASS. This gamepass is ONLY for the Buster item skins.
